# artoo

This is an **Artoo artifact**: kind `note`, form `article`, slug `artoo-landing`. `artifact.toml` is the source of truth; only `site/` can publish.

## Work here

1. Read `work/design-brief.md` before changing the presentation.
2. Keep research and intermediate files outside `site/`.
3. Keep runtime assets local: no CDN scripts, fonts, or stylesheets.
4. Use declared library classes; do not guess inside `article-`, `provenance`.
5. Keep source vintages, denominators, and limits beside the claims they qualify.
6. Draw structure as Mermaid; read `artoo docs artoo-diagrams` first.
7. Revise by editing the page in place; never regenerate a whole page to change part of it.

Saving shared data from the page: `artoo docs serve`.

## Review and ownership

Keep this artifact in the repository that owns its subject. Record a private, revision-bound finding with `artoo review . "finding" --page index.html`; resolve it with `--resolves <id>` once the new render is checked. A green check is not publication approval. See `artoo docs review`.

## Check it

Run `artoo build .` after edits: it renders content, packs data, applies the firewall, and checks links, assets, markup, evidence and design lint. With Playwright it also opens each page in Chromium at phone and desktop width and writes `work/verification/contact-sheet.png`. Fix what findings name (page, element, source line), then look at the contact sheet once; do not loop on screenshots.

Open `ARTOO_REFERENCE.md` only when you need the full vendored class vocabulary, firewall detail, or command reference. `artoo docs` has the complete tool reference.
